d: Nearly 30 Indian investors have reported unauthorised sales of their US stock portfolios through Bengaluru-based investment platform Stockal. Shares of companies like Apple, Tesla and Nvidia were allegedly sold without their permission, with the proceeds used to buy stock in a little-known Chinese company listed on Nasdaq. The value of the unauthorised transactions is estimated at over ₹100 crore. Stockal and its US-based brokerage partner DriveWealth have offered differing accounts of the security breach. Palki Sharma examines what happened and why investors are demanding answers.
